topics.title: Write a paragraph about your life in twenty years' time.
guiding_questions: How old will you be in twenty years?
Will you be married? How many children?
What kind of house will you live in?
How will technology change your daily life?
topics.sample_essay: In twenty years, I will be thirty-five years old. I will be married and have two children. I will work as an English teacher because I love this subject. We will live in a comfortable house with a small garden. I will enjoy music and have a great collection. Technology will make our lives easier.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about your future house.
guiding_questions: Where will your future house be?
What will its design look like?
What special features will it have?
How will technology help inside your house?
topics.sample_essay: My future house will be in the countryside near a river. It will be large with big windows and a beautiful garden. The design will be modern. It will have smart rooms and a rooftop farm. Robots will clean and cook our meals. Scientists predict such houses will be common. I will live there happily.
